_comment: Vendored fonts (TTFs per catalog key, plus the fallback and emoji faces) for the native text tests and the degraded tier. Originally fetched by tools/oracle/fetch-fonts.mjs; the MSDF atlases and metrics it also vendored were dropped with the MSDF lane.
_vector_fallbacks_note: CJK fallback variants merged by --vector-fallbacks (http://localhost:8000 canvas=f89bf2ec-3c80-48ad-ad2d-614018a8962a team=7a8b6548-58a3-4aa2-a6c4-df98423596a4) at 2026-07-30T18:42:26.435Z
_variant_gap_ttf_note: Fraunces-700-normal TTF merged (files-only, NO keys[] entry) for the vector text lane of fixtures/scenes/text/variant-gap (task #72 / Q-115): the browser vector engine renders bold Fraunces from the catalog TTF, so the linebox oracle + native vector engine need the bytes; the MSDF ATLAS for 700-normal stays deliberately unvendored — that gap is exactly what the fixture pins (FontMissing scream + text:variant-gap manifest).
_script_fallbacks_note: Broad-script vector fallback variants (Noto Sans <script> / Noto Serif Tibetan, 400-normal TTF + BMFont metrics, atlasPaths:null) merged for the vector text lane — mirrors the CJK --vector-fallbacks structure so uncovered non-Latin scripts render natively instead of blank/browser-fallback. Sourced from the platform font catalog.
_complex_script_fallbacks_note: Rare complex-script Noto fallback faces (Syriac, Thaana, N'Ko, Samaritan, Mandaic, Adlam, Mongolian, Brahmi, Limbu, Tai Tham, Hanifi Rohingya) vendored TTF-only (vectorOnly=true, metricsPath=null, no MSDF atlas) so the cosmic-text (degraded) lane resolves them by coverage and shapes them correctly — completing complex-script coverage to 100% (the #7275 residual). Sourced from notofonts.github.io unhinted TTFs (OFL-1.1). These blocks route to cosmic via moda_text::complex_script and are never MSDF-atlas'd, so AtlasStore::load_from_manifest skips vectorOnly keys.
_common_family_weights_note: Additional common-weight TTFs (files-only, no keys[] entry — like the Fraunces-700 variant-gap TTF) vendored byte-identically from the platform CDN (cdn.moda.app, the same bytes the browser loads) so the warm vector lane resolves the full common-weight range (400/500/600/700 + 400 italic) of the baked common families in NATIVE_RENDER_BAKED_FONT_FAMILIES (Inter, Noto Sans, Montserrat, Lato) directly from /opt/moda/native/fonts — no per-canvas fetch.
_faces_note: explicit faces merged by --faces (from-json local_catalog.json) at 2026-09-11T05:59:37.512Z
_cjk_subset_note: Noto Sans JP/KR/SC/TC 400 TTFs are vendored as glyph-id-preserving SUBSETS (files[].subsetOf records the full CDN file's sha256/bytes): the glyphs oracle-vector/glyph-curves.json pins plus the scene corpus's characters, so the repo stays small. Regenerate with scripts/oracle/subset-cjk-fonts.py <dir of full CDN TTFs>. Their MSDF metrics JSONs are the full CDN files.
_stix_two_math_note: STIX Two Math 2.13 b171 (OFL-1.1, stix-two-math/OFL.txt), the unmodified upstream TTF at stipub/stixfonts tag v2.13b171, vendored TTF-only (vectorOnly, no MSDF): the last face of the symbol fallback chains (scriptFallback.ts / script_fallback.rs), for symbols neither Noto Sans Math nor Noto Sans Symbols 2 has (U+2301, U+2613, ...). The same bytes as packages/editor/public/fonts/stix/.
